item.title: Khong Guan Corporation Issues Recall of Glutinous Rice Balls With Black Sesame Filling Due to Undeclared Peanuts
item.description: Khong Guan Corporation is recalling specific lots of “Glutinous Rice Balls with Black Sesame Filling” because they may contain undeclared peanuts. People who have an allergy or severe sensitivity to peanuts run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reactions if they consume these products
item.dc:creator: FDA
